obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your tenancy account

results.segment: Your appointment about your tenancy account with Ashcombe Housing Trust is booked for 28 August 2026 at 10.40am.
Please switch your telephone off in the waiting area.
Please bring the original certificate rather than a photocopy when you come in.
Please allow extra time if you are travelling by bus.
Please register for an online account before you attend.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
There is no charge for this service and none will be raised.
